title: Sentence-Level Topic Modeling with Lexical and Contextual Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.23388v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Topic modeling faces a fundamental granularity dilemma: probabilistic topic models assign topics at the word level, whereas transformer-based methods operate at the document level. The latter overlooks that real-world documents typically cover multiple topics, whereas the former relies on individual words, which rarely provide sufficient context to identify them. We introduce SentenceETM, a neural topic model that assigns a topic to each sentence by jointly using lexical and contextual evidence. Each topic is described both by a distribution over the vocabulary, defined through word embeddings, and by a Gaussian over sentence embeddings concentrated on a topic-specific low-dimensional subspace. The topic of a sentence generates both its words and its embedding and is marginalized exactly, so that its posterior combines the two sources of evidence. translated_title: 基于词汇与上下文证据的句子级主题建模
translated_abstract: 主题建模面临一个根本性的粒度困境：概率主题模型在词级别分配主题，而基于Transformer的方法则在文档级别进行操作。后者忽视了现实世界中的文档通常涵盖多个主题这一事实，而前者依赖于单个词语，但单个词语很少能提供足够识别主题所需的上下文。我们提出了SentenceETM，这是一种神经主题模型，通过联合利用词汇证据和上下文证据，为每个句子分配一个主题。每个主题同时由两种方式描述：一是通过词嵌入定义的词表上的分布，二是集中于主题特定低维子空间的句子嵌入上的高斯分布。句子的主题同时生成其词语和句子嵌入，并被精确地边缘化，使其后验分布能够结合这两种证据来源。文档的主题比例通过摊销变分推断来推断，而高斯……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: SentenceETM提出了一种句子级神经主题模型，通过联合利用词汇分布与句子嵌入上下文这两种证据来源，有效解决了主题建模中词级模型缺乏上下文、文档级模型忽视多主题共存问题的粒度困境。
en_tdlr: SentenceETM is a neural topic model that assigns topics at the sentence level by jointly leveraging lexical evidence (word distributions via embeddings) and contextual evidence (Gaussian distributions over sentence embeddings), resolving the granularity dilemma between word-level and document-level topic modeling.
